Lee]] *[[Steward Lee]] *[[Justin Ridge]]{{Rebels|Art Attack}} |executive producers=*Dave Filoni *Simon Kinberg *Greg Weisman |production company= |starring=*[[Freddie Prinze Jr.]] *[[Vanessa Marshall]] *[[Steve Blum]] *[[Tiya Sircar]] *[[Taylor Gray]] *Dave Filoni *[[David Oyelowo]] *[[Jason Isaacs]] *[[Liam O'Brien]] *[[David Shaughnessy]] *[[Dee Bradley Baker]] *[[Stephen Stanton]] |timeline=[[5 BBY]]–[[4 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' |preceded by= |followed by=[[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|''Star Wars Rebels'' Season Two]] }} '''''Star Wars Rebels'' Season One''' is the first season of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. The season premiered on [[October 3]], [[2014]] on the [[Disney Channel]], beginning with the one-hour television movie ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]''. The full series began on [[Disney XD]] with the premiere of the episode "[[Droids in Distress]]" on [[October 13]], and it ended with "[[Fire Across the Galaxy]]" on [[March 2]], [[2015]]. The season is executive produced by [[Dave Filoni]], [[Simon Kinberg]], and [[Greg Weisman]]. Set five years before [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first season follows the [[Spectres|crew]] of the starship ''[[Ghost]]'' in the early days of the fight against the [[Galactic Empire]]. The crew attracts the attention of [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau]], who wants to eliminate them as a threat before they can spark a wider rebellion, and [[the Grand Inquisitor]], a [[Dark side of the Force|dark sider]] who is tasked with killing any [[Jedi]] who survived [[Order 66]]—including [[Kanan Jarrus]] and his new [[Padawan|apprentice]], [[Ezra Bridger]]. The crew of the ''Ghost'' will eventually help form the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. ==Development== The first episode of the series was scripted and had begun the animation process by [[December]] [[2013]].{{InsiderCite|146|Launchpad|Launch Pad}} By [[January]] 2014, Season One's scripts had been halfway completed, with voice recording finished for five episodes and other episodes in various stages of production.{{InsiderCite|147|Launchpad|Launch Pad}} On [[January 17]], animation supervisor [[Keith Kellogg]] announced that the first episode had been fully animated.{{Twitter|Keith_Kellogg|statuses/424435812319522816|[[Keith Kellogg]]|quote=Just finished animation on the first episode of #StarWarsRebels. Can't wait for you all to see it.|archivedate=20160913043713}} On [[May 9]], 2014, Simon Kinberg confirmed that season one would contain 16 episodes (released as four shorts, a movie, and 13 episodes), and that he had personally written the first two episodes (which were later rebranded as a movie) as well as the season finale.{{WebCite|url=https://collider.com/star-wars-rebels-details-simon-kinberg|text=Writer-Producer Simon Kinberg Talks STAR WARS REBELS, His Duties on the Show, and the Thrill of Writing for Original Trilogy Characters|author=Goldberg, Matt|date=2014-05-09|work=Collider|archivedate=20200701055637}} ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|imagecat=Images from Star Wars Rebels Season One|soundcat=Audio files from Star Wars Rebels Season One}} ===Episodes=== {|class="wikitable sortable" {{Prettytable}} |- bgcolor="#CCCCCC" !
